problem_description: Compute the average_temperature in K for a solvated 5-mer peptide (any combination) using a CHARMM-compatible all-atom force field in real units. The system is evolved in the NVT ensemble at 275 K using a Nose-Hoover thermostat, with nonbonded interactions described by a CHARMM-style Lennard-Jones potential with a force-switching scheme and long-range electrostatics treated via the PPPM method with tolerence 10^{-4}. The bond and improper dihedral are handelled by harmonic, and angle & dihedral should be in charmm. Fast bond and angle vibrations involving hydrogens are constrained using the SHAKE algorithm, allowing stable integration with a 2 fs timestep. The simulation is run for a total of 10,000 timesteps.
